The author traces a three-layer independent failure chain: WSLg's clipboard synchronization only uses the outdated BMP format (which Claude Code cannot read), WSLg silently overwrites manual fixes, and Windows Terminal intercepts the Ctrl+V shortcut. The article offers a complete engineering solution: a Windows-side listener program (clip-listener.exe) that encodes images as PNG, a Linux-side script (wsl-clip-bridge) that pushes to the Linux clipboard and re-asserts after being overwritten, and an Alt+V alternative shortcut binding.
